name: INTERVIEW_SCHEDULER
description: Interview scheduling: slot proposals from interviewer availability (Asia/Kolkata working hours, buffers, daily maximum, time off, panel intersection, no double booking), RFC 5545/5546 iCalendar invitations built with the stdlib (METHOD:REQUEST/CANCEL, stable UID, SEQUENCE incremented on reschedule), invitation e-mails as drafts that a person approves (nothing is sent), candidate self-schedule tokens (hashed, expiring), a reminders list, and no-show handling that never rejects anyone.

harness.purpose: INTERVIEW_SCHEDULER: who can interview when, bookings, invitations as drafts, self-scheduling, reminders, no-shows.

excluded.issue_schedule_token: the method returns a secret, which would pass through the model
